issues.issue: Newsletter contains only titles and links - no insight
issues.evidence: output/insight-newsletter-v2.md provides 'Why it matters' but it's generic pattern matching, not content analysis

issues.issue: Theme detection is naive - counts stories per source as 'momentum'
issues.evidence: Rust blog stories tagged as 'rust momentum' is tautological, not insight

issues.issue: No full content extraction from articles
issues.evidence: Content extraction returns 7 chars for Distill.pub articles (likely blocked or failed)

issues.issue: Cron jobs report '100% success' on RSS fetch count, not usefulness
issues.evidence: test-output/content_extraction_test_report.md validates entry count, not insight quality

criteria: Extract and summarize full article content (not just RSS snippet)
Explain why each story matters to practitioners
Detect cross-source themes (not just count per-source stories)
Surface community sentiment from HN/Lobsters comments
Highlight gaps between hype and reality

root_cause.problem: Confused output artifacts with validated outcomes
root_cause.explanation: STATUS.json marked briefing_generation 'complete' because files exist (briefing_generator.py, demo-briefing-2026-03-21.md). But existence != usefulness. No human or automated evaluation of output quality was performed.
root_cause.systemic_issue: Cron agents optimize for task completion (closing beads tasks) not value delivery

immediate: Add quality gate: newsletter must be reviewed by practitioner before 'complete'
Stop cron agents from self-reporting success on vanity metrics
short_term: Implement content extraction service (Jina AI or similar)
Add LLM summarization with Claude API
Build cross-source theme detection (not per-source counting)
process_fix: Require human validation checkpoint before marking research tasks complete
Add 'user_value_validation' gate to all research labs
Cron agents must report blockers, not claim completion
